jobs.title: Program Coordinator_School Partnership
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Program Coordinator leads day-to-day planning, implementation, and documentation of Eden Youth’s integrated youth substance use prevention portfolio, including scheduling and partnerships with districts and school sites. Current programs include Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, Stanford REACH Lab prevention curricula (such as Smart Talk, opioid/fentanyl awareness, Our Healthy Futures, and age-appropriate vape-free education), and the Familia Adelante curriculum and family workshops. The Coordinator aligns program delivery with school calendars, grant requirements, evaluation protocols, and the Senior Program Manager’s priorities, and incorporates youth voice throughout. The position also supervises, trains, and coaches facilitators and peer educators. This is a prevention role; it does not provide substance use disorder diagnosis or clinical treatment.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**School partnerships and implementation**

Serve as the primary liaison between schools, districts, staff, and community partners to coordinate program planning, approvals, scheduling, referrals, and implementation. Ensure culturally responsive, age-appropriate, and accessible services across middle and high schools, including seasonal programming. Maintain site trackers to monitor attendance, program delivery, evaluations, staffing, challenges, and follow-up actions while supporting partnership agreements and renewals.

**Stanford REACH Lab curricula and appropriate intervention**

Coordinate the effective delivery of Stanford REACH Lab substance-use prevention curricula, including cannabis, vaping, opioid/fentanyl awareness, and alternatives to suspension. Schedule and support trained educators, monitor curriculum fidelity, and address implementation concerns. Collaborate with school teams to manage referrals, ensure confidential student support, and coordinate pre/post-surveys using approved Stanford data collection tools.

**Friday Night Live and youth leadership**

Coordinate Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, youth leadership meetings, prevention campaigns, and school activities while promoting youth participation and ownership. Collaborate with the Youth Advisory Council (YAC) on youth-led projects, community outreach, and advocacy. Train and mentor youth leaders in communication, project planning, inclusive leadership, prevention messaging, and responsible reporting.

**Familia Adelante and caregiver engagement**

Coordinate culturally responsive Familia Adelante workshops and caregiver education in partnership with schools, families, and bilingual facilitators. Manage outreach, scheduling, translation and interpretation, registration, attendance, and follow-up while maintaining confidentiality. Ensure county-funded program requirements are met and documented separately from other funded activities.

**Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Health Connections**

Introduce ECM and Community Connect services to school counselors, family engagement staff, and student support teams. Identify potential referral opportunities for students and families experiencing complex health or social needs. Coordinate referrals to staff for Medi-Cal and CYBHI eligibility verification, assessment, and enrollment determination. Support connections to behavioral health services, and other community programs. Follow up on referral coordination while maintaining confidentiality and respecting family consent.

**Deliverables, evaluation, and contract compliance**

Maintain funder-specific work plans, documentation, and reporting to ensure contract compliance and prevent duplicate billing or reporting. Coordinate accurate data collection, timely submissions, evaluations, and quality assurance. Support county reporting deadlines, annual prevention planning, stakeholder feedback, and continuous program improvement. Collaborate with management and partners to fulfill prevention and youth engagement deliverables.

**Team coordination, safety, and professionalism**

Provide guidance, onboarding, and coaching to peer educators, youth specialists, and interns while collaborating with supervisors to support team development, staffing needs, and program effectiveness. Ensure compliance with mandated reporting, youth safety, district policies, confidentiality, and trauma-informed practices. Participate in required professional development to maintain program quality and professionalism.

**QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)**

Strong organizational, coordination, and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple school sites, and concurrent program deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with students, families, school personnel, staff, and community partners.

Exercises sound judgment, makes well-reasoned decisions, and develops practical solutions to operational and program-related challenges.

Demonstrates adaptability, embraces responsible organizational change, and supports continuous improvement in alignment with the organization's mission.

Maintains a results-oriented approach, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets established deadlines and performance expectations.

Demonstrates active listening, cultural humility, and respect for diverse perspectives while modeling inclusive and professional behavior.

Demonstrates accountability, ethical conduct, professionalism, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Required Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with at least two years coordinating youth, school-based, prevention, or community programs.

Strong organizational, communication, relationship-building, and culturally responsive facilitation skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft 365, data tracking, and reporting systems.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. **Job ID:** LP\_00024850-2661065

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

The Program Coordinator is responsible for operational issues related to supporting programs/activities, including, but not limited to, overseeing and coordinating the day-to-day operations and resources. Serves as a resource for staff, faculty, outside agencies/institutions, and customers. Coordinating the programs, including scheduling, maintaining calendars, website updates, financial accounting, coordinating conferences, and managing travel arrangements. * Facilitate and analyze budgeting activities to optimize programs.
* Creates and manages complex programs, spreadsheets, databases, reports, queries, charts, etc., based on department projects or activities/objectives.
* Coordinates and organizes special events, conferences, and meetings (staff and patient-focused), including planning, facilitation, and implementation.

jobs.title: Bilingual Case Manager II
jobs.description:
Catholic Charities Housing Support Services “To provide individual and crisis intervention counseling and services to program clients in order to ensure opportunity for clients to maintain their housing. To implement and deliver all aspects of peer support and to assist program participants in achieving short- and long-term goals.”

The Case Manager will be responsible for core housing case management, benefits advocacy, support services for physical and mental health – acute/chronic, and problem solving. Provide assistance to people accessing other applicable housing opportunities. Assist clients in maintaining or increasing their housing stabilization.

Working to assess the Participants needs, by providing immediate services, personal goals, and services plans. This position will work with Participants around self-sufficiency, and how to maintain independence and prevent homelessness. Through the program, clients may receive case management referrals to community support and counseling.

The Case Manager provides advocacy and referral services as needed to Participants, and where possible, assist with maintaining housing.

* Caseload portfolio assignment up to 35-40 clients
* Provide comprehensive screening and assessment of clients and services needed.
* Develop person centered care plans: provide counseling, monitoring and care plan changes as necessary.
* Arrange for services to meet the client’s needs as documented in the care plan to address the immediate and long-term needs of clients.
* Provide practical support, education and assistance to tenants in addressing immediate needs related to achieving stability and life management skills, with a minimum of monthly client contact.
* Coordinate with the Catholic Charities CYO programs and community agencies to ensure communication and quality service to the clients.
* Provide on-going support including but not limited to the following: information and referral for services, client contact, and assist in meeting the goals of the client’s service plan.
* Comply with program policies and procedures to protect client and caregiver interests and facilitate the smooth operation of the program.
* Maintain accurate, current, and complete client files and complete all required data collection forms and reports. Maintain appropriate records for monthly reports.
* Data entry into CARES Systems and completion of monthly reports.
* Participate in staff meetings, client peer reviews, in-services and other training as required.
* Coordinate contact with collaborative agencies as needed to identify any client issues that might result in an improved or destabilize a housing and to conduct an appropriate intervention as required
* Interface with other agencies and departments to ensure appropriate client compliance with Program requirements.
* Other duties as assigned
* Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education & Experience:**

* BA degree and one year of experience preferred or AA degree and three years related experience. (Equivalent education and experience demonstrating the ability to perform the job may be considered.)
* Two years experience providing client case management services with the housing insecure population and/or service programs preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Knowledge of San Francisco County social services networks.
* Sensitivity to and possess a knowledge of services for seniors and adults with disabilities, homelessness/unstable housing, substance use disorders, and associated Healthcare [physical and mental health – acute/chronic] issues.
* Certified or familiarity with HCV/Housing Quality Standards.
* Interacting with persons from various social, cultural, economic, and educational backgrounds for the purpose of stabilizing or improving housing situations.
* Bilingual in Spanish, Tagalog, Mandarin/Chinese, or other language preferred.
* Functional knowledge of Microsoft Office Products.
* Ability to perform duties with minimum supervision.
* Ability to communicate clearly in both verbal and written forms.
* Promote a positive professional and organizational image in the community.

* Demonstrates the necessary attitudes, knowledge and skills to deliver culturally competent services and work effectively in cross-cultural situations.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bonsai Robotics**

Bonsai Robotics develops affordable, vision-based autonomy that makes off-road equipment smarter, safer, and more productive. We are redefining outdoor autonomy with Bonsai Intelligence, a connected platform that’s inspired by biology to see, think, and act with precision like a human. We bring together advanced perception, embodied AI, integrations with equipment manufacturers, and our compact, modular Amiga vehicles to deliver reliable automation to the world’s most demanding field operations—reducing costs and increasing operational efficiencies.

**About the role**

We’re looking for an Office Manager to keep our San Jose and Watsonville offices running smoothly. You’ll be the go-to person for everything that makes the workplace work, from facilities and vendors to supplies, mail, and the day-to-day details that help our team stay focused on building robots.

This role splits time between both offices. You’ll own internal office projects from start to finish, support our real estate needs as we grow, and provide hands-on support to our leadership team. It’s a great fit for someone who is organized, resourceful, and enjoys building structure in a fast-moving startup.

**What you'll do**

* Manage day-to-day operations for our San Jose and Watsonville offices, including facilities, maintenance, vendors, badge access, and office equipment
* Lead internal office projects like space planning, moves, buildouts, and workplace improvements, from scoping through completion
* Support real estate needs, including lease administration, landlord communication, and coordination with brokers
* Order and stock snacks, beverages, and supplies for both offices, and manage related budgets and vendor relationships
* Open, scan, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and manage outgoing shipments
* Provide executive support, including calendar coordination, meeting logistics, and ad hoc projects
* Coordinate company wide events, on-site meetings, visitor check-in, and in-office lunches
* Travel regularly between the San Jose and Watsonville offices to keep both sites running consistently

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in office management, facilities, or administrative operations, ideally at a startup or tech company
* Experience supporting multiple office locations or a distributed team
* Exposure to real estate, lease administration, or facilities projects is a plus
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping details
* Clear, professional communicator who’s comfortable working with executives, vendors, and landlords
* Proficient with Google Workspace and quick to pick up new tools
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for regular travel between San Jose and Watsonville
* Self-starter who takes ownership and brings a positive, service-minded approach

**Life at Bonsai Robotics**

At Bonsai, we're building the future of robotics and we know that means investing in our people. We're committed to creating a workplace where you can do your best work, grow your skills, and feel genuinely part of something bigger.

**Hybrid Flexibility (for selective roles)**

We operate on a hybrid model because we believe the best collaboration happens both in person and from where you work best. You'll have the flexibility to split your time between our office and home, so you can stay connected to the team while maintaining the balance that works for you.

**Work-life Balance**

The best employees are those who create balance in their lives, which is why we prioritize balance and well-being for everyone at Bonsai. We foster a supportive environment where teammates look out for each other.

**Covered Lunch**

On in-office days, we've got lunch covered. It's a small thing that makes a big difference, with more time to connect with teammates and less to worry about.

**Wellness and Benefits**

Your health matters. We offer comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), mental health support, and wellness programs designed to help you thrive both physically and mentally.

**Collaborative Culture**

At Bonsai, you're not just part of a team, you're part of a community. We celebrate wins together, support each other through challenges, and genuinely enjoy the people we work with. From team events to cross-functional collaboration, we're building something together.

**Mission-driven Work**

Every day, you're contributing to advancements in robotics that matter. If you're excited about innovation and impact, you'll find it here.

Bonsai Robotics is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 75,000 USD per year(San Jose)

**Summary -** Serving as the face of BeneSys at a client level, the **Plan Associate II** position is responsible for working alongside Plan Management to administer various employee benefit plans including, Health & Welfare, Pension, Vacation, Apprenticeship and Supplemental Unemployment Benefit Funds. This position serves as the **Office Manager** for the San Francisco office. The position is considered “exempt” under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

**Plan Associate II Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but not limited to**

* Ability to take full responsibility for a Fund and/or Client.
* Exercise discretion and confidentiality in matters relating to administration of employee benefit plans.
* Prepare for and present at participant meetings and health fairs.
* Respond to participant appeals.
* Create and maintain Barometers and other meeting reports.
* Calculate PBGC premiums.
* Timely review and process Trustee expense reports and payroll reimbursements.
* Manage government audit process and coordinate payroll audits. Complete all other audits independently and in time.
* Prepare month-end reports.
* Answer questions from vendors, professionals and legal counsel without supervision and using sound judgment and solid problem-solving skills.

* Trouble-shoot issues to ensure that client-specific procedures are understood, correctly implemented, and routinely followed.
* Draft participant communications.
* Compile data needed for annual health and pension plan valuations.
* Exercise discretion and confidentiality in matters relating to administration of employee benefit plans.

* Set up and maintain administrative paper and electronic files. including maintaining meeting files.
* Prepare participant, contractor, and Trustee mailings.
* Timely direct subpoenas, Medicare notices, and other notices to the departments for handling
* Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this job.
* Duties may vary depending on individual Fund staffing.

* Work with vendors regarding all office needs.
* Compiling the supply list monthly and submit order by the 15th and 30th of each month.
* Work with IT department for any office needs.
* Liaison between Property Management & Office.
* Partner with HR to ensure all BeneSys rules/procedures are followed.
* Assign and track all keycards and fobs to the office.
* Conduct HIPAA quarterly desk audits.
* Maintain bulletin boards in kitchen/breakroom.
* UPS and postage report, weekly/monthly.
* Plan and organize office events within the approved budget.

**Language Skills -** Ability to read, analyze and interpret general correspondence. Ability to prepare reports, draft meeting minutes and correspond with Fund vendors, participants and Trustees. Ability to effectively present information and respond to inquiries from managers, clients, vendors and participants. Strong writing and editing skills are a must.

**Reasoning Skills -** Ability to interpret and follow a variety of instructions furnished in written or oral form. Must be attentive to detail and disciplined in meeting deadlines and setting priorities.

**Math Skills -** Capable of applying intermediate level math skills, including concepts of fractions, percentages and decimals, in addition to basic concepts of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

**Physical Demands -** Position requires the ability to travel to offsite locations to attend Trustee meetings. There may be some occasional light lifting and require some periods of sustained keyboarding. jobs.title: Sales & Operations Lead (Management Track)
jobs.description:
**Fem Boudoir Photo Studio| Concord, CA**

**Location:** Concord, CA | **This is a hybrid position**  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific  
**Compensation:** $55,000 Annual Base + Performance-Based Bonuses  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, W-2

About Fem Boudoir:

Fem Boudoir is a growing luxury boudoir photography studio based in Concord, California. We specialize in creating empowering, confidence-building photography experiences that help our clients see themselves in a whole new light.

We're a passionate team dedicated to providing an exceptional client experience, and we're looking for someone who is excited to grow with us.

**This isn't just another sales position. We're looking for someone with the potential to become a future leader of our company.**

About the Role:

We're seeking a motivated, personable, and results-driven Sales & Operations Lead to join our team.

Your primary focus will initially be managing incoming leads, conducting phone consultations, and converting prospective clients into booked photography sessions.

As you demonstrate strong sales performance, initiative, and leadership ability, you'll have the opportunity to take on additional operational responsibilities and potentially grow into an Operations Manager or General Manager role.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just wait to be told what to do, but takes ownership, identifies opportunities, and actively contributes to the success of the business.

What You'll Do:

**Sales & Client Experience**

* Conduct engaging phone consultations with prospective clients who have expressed interest in our photography experiences.
* Build genuine relationships, understand client needs, and confidently communicate the value of our services.
* Convert qualified leads into booked sessions while clearly communicating pricing expectations and the overall experience.
* Follow up with prospective clients through phone calls, texts, and emails.
* Handle questions and objections with confidence, empathy, and professionalism.
* Maintain accurate client information and follow-up activities in our CRM.
* Track booking performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

**Operations & Leadership Development**

* Proactively identify ways to improve workflows, client communication, and booking systems.
* Help coordinate schedules and communication between team members.
* Monitor key performance indicators and provide regular updates.
* Assist with resolving client concerns and operational challenges.
* Support team training, accountability, and process improvements as responsibilities expand.
* Gradually take on additional leadership responsibilities based on performance and business needs.

What We're Looking For:

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 2 years of successful phone sales, consultative sales, or appointment-closing experience.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to make people feel comfortable and confident.
* Highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to take ownership.
* Comfortable using CRM software and learning new technology.
* Genuine interest in professional growth and leadership.
* Must live within reasonable commuting distance of Concord, CA.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in high-ticket sales, luxury services, beauty, wellness, or photography.
* Experience with GoHighLevel, HoneyBook, or similar CRM systems.
* Previous experience training, mentoring, or leading a team.
* Experience working in a growing small business.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You're someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and helping them make confident decisions.

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. We have an opening for a **Mission Partner Sites IT Operations Associate** to oversee complex projects within the Enterprise Secure Network (ESN) Program and Mission Partner Sites. This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work. This position is in the Information Technology Solutions Division (ITSD) within the Computing Directorate, in support of the LivIT Program.

* Contribute to the lines of effort required to onboard and deploy ESN connectivity to Mission Partner Sites.

* Monitor, track, and report site integration status to ESN Program.

* Travel to customer sites to facilitate the deployment of new enterprise hardware.
* Maintain technical deployment schedules, prioritize work, track deliverables, administer the MPS Field Service Management tool, and update ServiceNow hardware asset records.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.

* Knowledge and experience working on technical projects.

$107,610 - $136,500 Annually

Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

Responsibilities
  
  
The Global Business Marketing (GBM) team champions TikTok in the B2B landscape, showing advertisers and sales teams how TikTok's creative ecosystem drives real business results. We build the stories, education, and go-to-market programs that sellers use to deepen client relationships across markets. Working with brands of all sizes, we also bring campaigns to life through creative ideation, brand and event strategy, and the design and production of TikTok for Business marketing, so advertisers can create content that connect with audiences. Trends, consumer behavior, and advertising formats all move quickly on TikTok. The challenge is turning what makes the platform engaging into solutions that are creative, measurable, and scalable across very different markets, without making the experience feel like traditional advertising. You will shape how the market understands TikTok as a business platform, and help brands show up authentically on it. Our Product MarComs (PMC) & Industry Enablement (IE) sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Data and Customer Experience. We build the knowledge, education, intelligence and measurement capabilities that help turn product innovation and marketing interventions into measurable customer and business outcomes. Our work spans customer and seller experiences including the Business Resource Center, in-product education, sales enablement and AI-powered education experiences. As these experiences become increasingly connected, our measurement approach must evolve as well—from measuring individual programs and channels to understanding how knowledge, education and marketing interventions influence customer behavior across the journey. We are building a measurement and experimentation capability that connects customer engagement to activation, product adoption, expansion and business growth. We're seeking an experienced Program Manager, Measurement & Experimentation to build the measurement foundation that enables data-driven decision making across product knowledge, education and customer enablement experiences. Today, customer and seller interactions occur across multiple surfaces and systems. Traffic, engagement, learning activity, AI interactions, product behavior and commercial outcomes are often measured independently, making it difficult to understand the complete customer journey or determine which interventions actually drive behavior. This role will help change that. Responsibilities Build a Connected Measurement Architecture - Develop scalable measurement frameworks to evaluate the business impact of product knowledge, education, and enablement initiatives across the customer journey. - Define standardized metrics, event taxonomies, and measurement requirements across reach, engagement, learning, activation, product adoption, and commercial outcomes. - Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to integrate data across systems, improve measurement capabilities, and connect customer engagement to downstream business outcomes. Connect Engagement to Business Outcomes - Develop measurement frameworks that connect customer and seller engagement to measurable behavioral and business outcomes beyond traditional engagement metrics. - Define leading and lagging indicators to assess the impact of knowledge and education initiatives on activation, product adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue. - Establish attribution and measurement approaches to evaluate the effectiveness and business contribution of educational experiences and platforms, such as TikTok Academy and Business Help Center. **JOB** **TITLE****:** Quality Manager
  
**FLSA:** Exempt position  
**LOCATION:** Fremont, CA (Onsite)

**Job Summary:**

The Quality Manager oversees the Quality Engineering and Out-of-Box Audit (OBA) teams, ensuring that all manufacturing and product quality processes meet customer requirements, internal standards, and regulatory compliance. This role provides leadership, strategic direction, and coordination across the department, while promoting continuous improvement initiatives and effective cross-functional collaboration.

The Quality department is responsible for ensuring product quality throughout the manufacturing lifecycle, from New Product Introduction (NPI) and Mass Production (MP) support. The team monitors manufacturing performance, analyzes test data, drives yield improvement, and ensures compliance with customer requirements and industry standards. It works closely with cross-functional teams and suppliers to identify risks, resolve quality issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all activities of the Quality and OBA teams, including inspection planning, production quality monitoring, and final product audits

* Establish quality objectives, processes, and standards aligned with customer requirements and corporate policies

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing, supplier quality, and inspection processes

* Ensure the effective implementation of inspection plans, defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions

* Coordinate cross-functional collaboration between Quality, Process Engineering, Test Engineering, and suppliers

* Review and approve quality reports, metrics, and trend analyses for presentation to senior management and stakeholders

* Support internal and external audits, including ISO and customer-specific quality audits

* Monitor team performance, provide coaching and development, and ensure adherence to departmental procedures and standards

* Manage resources, staffing, and workflow to meet production schedules and quality requirements

* Identify risks and implement mitigation plans to prevent quality issues from impacting production or customer satisfaction

**Required Skills/Abilities:** **(Example of skills set)**

* Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience overseeing multiple technical teams.

* Deep knowledge of quality principles, inspection methodologies, and manufacturing processes.

* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement and implement corrective/preventive actions

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Effective communication skills to influence cross-functional teams, suppliers, and senior management.

* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools, including Microsoft Excel and quality management systems.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

* 3+ years of experience in a leadership or management role within a quality or manufacturing organization

* Experience with ISO standards, audits, and supplier quality management preferred.

**About the Role**

As a Quality Assurance Technician, you will play a vital role in upholding our commitment to precision by verifying that complex machined components meet rigorous engineering specifications. Your expertise in metrology and documentation will ensure that every part delivered to our clients adheres to the highest standards of excellence and reliability.

**Responsibilities**

* Execute comprehensive first-piece, in-process, and final inspections to validate CNC machined parts against technical blueprints.

* Prepare detailed First Article Inspection (FAI) reports and final certification packages to satisfy customer and QMS standards.
* Maintain the integrity of quality records by accurately logging inspection data into our digital tracking systems.
* Oversee the calibration status of precision measuring instruments to ensure ongoing measurement accuracy.
* Manage non-conforming material processes by identifying, documenting, and dispositioning discrepant components.
* Participate in internal and external audits to support continuous improvement and organizational quality goals.

**Qualifications**

#### **Required Skills**

* 6+ years of hands-on inspection experience within a precision machining environment.
* Proficiency with manual metrology tools including micrometers, calipers, height gages, and thread gages.
* Strong ability to interpret complex engineering drawings and apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles.
* Experience managing documentation for shipping and final quality certification.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple inspection priorities in a fast-paced shop.
* Competence in computer-based data entry and quality management software.

#### **Preferred Skills**

* Proven experience in CMM programming, specifically utilizing PC-DMIS software.
* Technical familiarity with optical comparators and air gaging techniques.
* Strong mathematical foundation, including the application of trigonometry in inspection.
* Prior experience maintaining gage calibration systems according to industry standards.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager I
jobs.description:
### **The Role**

You'll partner with plaintiff U.S. law firms, from small and mid-market practices to select enterprise accounts, to drive software adoption, retention, and account growth. In this role, you'll act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, helping legal teams transform their workflows and leverage our platform—including generative AI capabilities—to achieve meaningful business outcomes on their most critical matters.

**This is a full-time, exempt position based in our New York City, NY or Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**

What you'll do

* Own retention and growth across your book of business, driving renewals and identifying opportunities to expand usage
* Build multi-threaded relationships across law firm stakeholders, including day-to-day users, administrators, practice group leaders, and executive sponsors.
* Conduct regular check-in calls, strategic success reviews, and product demonstrations centered on usage data, business impact, and strategic alignment.
* Teach customers how to use platform features and workflows effectively, guiding them on best practices for adopting generative AI capabilities.
* Proactively identify retention risks, solve complex workflow challenges, and partner closely with Sales, User Education, Product, and Support to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* Share customer feedback, document best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Customer Success team.

About You

* You have at least 4 years of customer success experience managing a large book of mid-market and enterprise accounts within SaaS or consumption-based technology companies.
* You act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, using workflow expertise and data-driven account plans to influence customer behavior and drive adoption.
* You navigate complex client organizations effectively, building credibility, trust, and strong executive presence with senior leadership.
* You manage competing priorities proactively and possess exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

* Experience in legal tech, litigation software consulting, or related legal industry workflows.
* Experience working with AI tools (Claude, Glean, etc.) to optimize your day-to-day responsibilities

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

### **The Team — Customer Success**

The Customer Success team helps customers turn Everlaw's powerful technology into meaningful outcomes on their most important matters. As trusted advisors, the team builds lasting partnerships, guides adoption, and helps organizations integrate Everlaw into the way they work. By connecting customer priorities and feedback with teams across Everlaw, Customer Success helps customers realize sustained value while strengthening the relationships that drive retention and growth.

### **Total Rewards & Benefits**

The annual base salary for this position is between $116,000 - $148,000, with a total On-Target Earnings (OTE) of between $145,000 - $185,000, representing a 80/20 compensation split. Eligibility for the commission portion is performance-based and subject to the achievement of specific performance metrics, which are governed by Everlaw's policies and incentive plans. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate's experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

Health & well-being

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

* #LI-KV1
* #LI-Hybrid

About Everlaw

*At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.*

Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Global Business Applied AI, GBAI Operations
jobs.description:
The application window will be open until at least November 15, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.

Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, go-to-market strategy, sales operations, marketing, finance, or program/project management at a technology or media company.
* Experience with core business operations (e.g., annual business planning, headcount management, running business reviews, or target setting).
* Experience working with executive-level clients or stakeholders.
* Experience in sales operations, planning, and processes (e.g., forecasting, sales compensation, contracting).
* Experience with Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Excellent team-work and communication skills to synthesize complex findings into simple, compelling strategic narratives for executive audiences.
* Proven ability to structure complex, multi-variable issues, identify operational inefficiencies, and build innovative processes that prevent future roadblocks.
* Impeccable business judgment to confidently navigate senior-leader pushback, maintain composure, and drive consensus in ambiguous situations.
* Successful track record operating within globally scaled product sales, engineering, or sales technology environments.
* Strong empathy for internal sellers, proposing innovative approaches while clearly outlining risks and trade-offs.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Product Operations team sits within the Global Business Applied AI (GBAI) team, and is responsible for leading sales tools strategy across business operations, governance, legal compliance, sales enablement, and measurement and analytics. GBAI resides within the Go to Market Operations (GTM) team and enables Google’s Business Organization (GBO) to drive customer success.

As a Strategy and Operations Lead in the Global Business Applied AI organization, you will drive complex, cross-functional projects and processes as a key contributor with limited guidance, owning critical business initiatives end-to-end. You will work directly with business executives, Director+-level stakeholders, and key leaders to unlock the full value of our internal sales tools.

You will be operating under extreme uncertainty, efficiently structuring highly ambiguous, complex problems, and generating clear, actionable insights. You will demonstrate strong decision-making leadership, a bias for action, and the ability to build trusted cross-functional partnerships across global product leads, engineering, product management, legal, compliance, and finance.

The Go-to-Market Operations (GtM) team ensures Google's complex and ever-evolving Ads business runs smoothly. We are instrumental in setting go-to-market strategy, and ensuring flawless execution and operations against the strategy. We have teams embedded in each of the major Ads business areas as well as global teams that work across the business areas. Team members are analytical and strategic, with a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $152000 - $221000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead and drive complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives and processes end-to-end with limited guidance, managing project scoping, planning, priorities, and milestones.
* Deconstruct highly ambiguous situations and solve complex problems that have multiple potential solutions, drawing on a wide toolkit to deliver clear insights and optimal, data-driven recommendations.
* Build and influence a broad network of relationships across the product area, including Director-level stakeholders, to align resources, build consensus on complex issues, and drive change management.
* Design reporting frameworks and analyze operational data to surface actionable insights, track progress against business objectives, and empower executive decision-making.
* Serve as a subject matter expert with a thorough understanding of the business area. Develop others by sharing expertise, teaching deep systems/product knowledge, and providing support/direction across adjacent workstreams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Account Manager, PV Cells
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla's Energy team is looking for a seasoned sales professional to drive cell sales and partnerships for Tesla’s in-house solar products. This role will primarily focus on the sale of solar cells to module manufacturing companies in the US. This senior position carries significant growth targets that are aligned with Tesla’s massive domestic solar manufacturing ambitions (100GW/yr). This role will be responsible for driving transactions from initial engagement to contract execution, while collaborating with Tesla’s commercial and technical support organizations.

  
**What You'll Do**

* Engage directly with module manufacturers and other solar cell buyers to drive new business opportunities, build the sales pipeline, and find creative ways to fundamentally grow the US market size
* Provide critical support throughout the sales cycle, including organization, customer engagement, technical/economic analysis, etc., to achieve a targeted product volume and/or revenue closed each year (quota bearing)
* Generate high quality, accurate quotes and proposals, often in response to highly complex and formal utility RFPs, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and Tesla strategic goals
* Lead the negotiation and execution of definitive supply agreements and other contractual agreements
* Work with product, business development, and marketing teams to create competitive product positioning, sales collateral, and collaborate on overall marketing strategy

  
**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in the solar industry, including experience working for a cell OEM or module OEM
* Direct experience managing a sales pipeline, negotiating equipment contracts and/or master supply agreements, establishing and maintaining executive customer relationships
* Deep knowledge of solar cell technologies, including technical and commercial trade-offs of various architectures and metrics
* Experience with China/Asia supply chains and fluency in Mandarin preferred
* Understanding of US tax policy impacts on project economics, including ITC/PTC structures and domestic content requirements
* Strong analytical skills – comfortable with technoeconomic modeling and presenting results clearly to customers and leadership
* Proven ability to operate effectively in highly cross-functional dynamic environments with incomplete information and frequent unknowns, adapting quickly to shifting market conditions, policy changes, supply-chain variability, and evolving manufacturing ramps while still driving toward ambitious volume targets

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$160,000 - $240,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

jobs.title: Member Services Representative
jobs.description:
Flynn Fitness is one of seven premier brands of Flynn Group, which has grown to be the largest franchise operator in the world. Flynn owns and operates a diversified portfolio of restaurants in iconic, world class brands across diverse segments, including Applebee’s, Arby’s, Panera Bread, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell, Wendy’s and Planet Fitness. Our primary mission is to be the premier operator within each of these brands. We will achieve this by focusing on our core values; Care Genuinely for People, Play like a Champion, and Win as One.

Planet Fitness prides itself on creating a unique environment where anyone – and we mean anyone – can be comfortable. A diverse, Judgement Free Zone where a lasting, active lifestyle can be built. This product is a tool, a means to an end; not a brand name or a mold-maker, but a tool that can be used by anyone. As we evolve and educate ourselves, we will seek to perfect this safe, energetic environment, where everyone feels accepted and respected.

We are searching for a Member Services Representative to join our team! As a member of our staff, you will be responsible for providing a superior level of customer service to Planet Fitness members, prospective members and guests, ensuring an exceptional “Judgement Free” member experience!

**Skills Required**

* Customer Service experience preferred
* Basic computer proficiency and strong attention to detail
* Consistent punctuality and reliability
* Strong communication skills
* Ability to work well in a team environment
* Willingness to learn and adapt
* Problem-solving mindset
* Ability to follow instructions and complete tasks independently

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Greet members and guests, always providing exceptional customer service.
* Answer phones courteously and assist callers with a variety of questions.
* Check members in and provide club tours to prospective members.
* Communicate updates and events to members and guests.
* Respond to member questions and concerns in a timely and professional manner.
* Conduct beverage or merchandise purchases on the point-of-sale system.
* Utilize POS system to assist with new memberships and existing membership questions.
* Go above and beyond to keep the front desk area and lobby clean and orderly.
* Regular cleaning and upkeep of the facility, including exercise equipment, amenities, windows, mirrors, trash removal, and re-racking weights.
* Support team operations by adapting to new policies, procedures, and systems, and completing required company training as assigned.
* Frequent restroom/locker room cleaning and stocking.
* Complete company assigned trainings and additional learning as directed.

* Ability to work in a busy, noisy fitness environment.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

You will be the second person on Revenue Operations, reporting directly to the Director of RevOps and working as his right hand. RevOps at Outset owns the full go-to-market stack and the numbers that run the business: Salesforce, HubSpot, routing, automations, ARR reporting, quota and comp tracking, sales process and policy. Today one person runs all of it, with AI tools doing a lot of the heavy lifting. Your job is to take real ownership of a growing share of that scope, fast.  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
*Systems and CRM*

* Administer Salesforce day to day: fields, record types, page layouts, permission sets, validation rules, flows, reports and dashboards.
* Keep the HubSpot Salesforce sync healthy, debug field and picklist mismatches, and own lead-to-opportunity data integrity.
* Maintain and extend our sales tool stack: Apollo, Momentum (call recording), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, meeting routing, Linear, Slack bots.
* Run user provisioning, onboarding and offboarding across the stack, and keep the integration users and connections tidy.

*Automation and AI*

* Build and maintain workflows in n8n that connect Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Linear and Google Workspace.
* Use Claude and other AI tools as a default working style: drafting SOQL and flows, writing runbooks, summarizing calls, prepping handover docs, pressure-testing analyses.
* Spot manual, repetitive work on the GTM team and remove it.

*Analytics and reporting*

* Own recurring reporting: weekly revenue breakouts, pipeline and stage hygiene, AE quota attainment and ramp, win/loss by segment and competitor.
* Keep ARR truth clean: reconcile ARR by contract, maintain customer and account-status definitions in Salesforce, and make sure nothing is double counted.
* Build dashboards leadership actually uses, in Salesforce, Google Sheets, or whatever tool fits, and be able to explain every number on them.
* Answer ad hoc questions from the CRO, finance and the board with fast, correct, well-caveated analysis.

*Sales process and enablement*

* Run pipeline hygiene: stale-opportunity nudges, stage definitions, close-date discipline, the Sales CS handover.
* Help draft and roll out sales policy such as Rules of Engagement, territory and lead routing, and comp plan mechanics, then enforce them in the system.
* Support deal desk work: order forms, pricing and discount checks, contract term extraction into Salesforce.
* Be the first call for AEs and SDRs when something in the stack is broken or confusing, and fix it or teach it.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or an adjacent seat at a B2B SaaS company (sales ops analyst, SDR or AE who moved into ops, BizOps, CS ops).
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: you have built reports and dashboards, edited fields and layouts, and ideally written a flow or two. Admin certification is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.description:
**About 1nHealth, Inc.**  
1nHealth is a software-centric patient recruitment company for the clinical research industry. We exist to fill studies, connecting patients with research. We have been active for 6 years as a bootstrapped startup that now has 45 employees and multiple clients in top Pharma, leading biotechnology companies, and many of the top Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in the space. Our mission is to advance human health and make a positive impact on patients, clients, and our team members all over the world.

We are growing and profitable. Our company is a client and employee centric meritocracy. If you're ready to be part of a team of highly intelligent professionals using technology for good, come join us at 1nHealth.

**About the role**

The Patient Coordinator (PC) Support Lead is a senior individual contributor role that combines the full responsibilities of a Patient Coordinator with a leadership layer: overseeing, coaching, and managing the performance of 1nHealth's contractor (vendor) PC team. This role is ideal for an experienced Patient Coordinator who demonstrates strong clinical knowledge, communication excellence, and the desire to develop and elevate others.

The PC Support Lead plays a critical dual role — remaining an active contributor in the pre-screening process while ensuring the contractor PC team meets quality standards, performance metrics, and compliance requirements.

**Duties and Responsibilities**  
  
**Patient Coordinator Duties**

* **Pre-Screening Calls:** Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls. Conduct thorough pre-screening calls with potential candidates remotely to gather medical history, demographics, and other relevant information as per trial protocols.
* **Patient Interaction:** Communicate clearly and compassionately with potential participants, explaining the purpose of clinical trials, eligibility criteria, and associated risks or benefits. Forge relationships with patients by going the extra mile.
* **Medical Terminology:** Demonstrate proficiency in medical terminology to accurately assess patient information and determine eligibility for clinical trials.
* **Technical Skills:** Utilize remote communication tools including Microsoft Outlook, SharePoint, RingCentral, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and other relevant software for conducting calls, documentation, and team communication.
* **Performance Metrics:** Meet or exceed KPIs related to pre-qualified referrals and downstream funnel outcomes such as enrollment rates and conversion ratios.
* **Documentation:** Maintain detailed and accurate records of patient interactions using remote documentation tools, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and trial-specific requirements.
* **Quality Assurance:** Adhere to established quality assurance protocols to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and trial-specific requirements.
* **Training and Development:** Participate in ongoing remote training sessions to stay updated on trial protocols, regulatory requirements, and best practices in patient engagement.
* **Communication:** Provide timely updates to relevant stakeholders regarding patient status, referral outcomes, and any issues or concerns that may arise during the pre-screening process.

**Contractor Team Oversight & Coaching**

* **Call Quality Review (QA):** Regularly review recorded calls from contractor PCs to evaluate adherence to scripts, regulatory requirements, and 1nHealth quality standards. Document findings and use them to inform coaching sessions.
* **KPI Dashboard Review:** Monitor the PC KPI dashboard on an ongoing basis to assess individual and team-level performance metrics. Proactively identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement across the contractor team.

* Delivering meaningful, individualized feedback to each direct report a minimum of twice per month.
* Escalating unresolved performance concerns to the PC Team Lead when coaching alone does not produce the necessary improvement.
* **Performance-Based Bonus Recommendations:** Evaluate contractor PC performance data and provide informed recommendations to the PC Team Lead regarding which team members should be considered for performance-based bonuses.
* **Timesheet Approval:** Review and approve contractor PC timesheets on a weekly basis, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* **Monthly Invoice Generation:** Compile and generate the monthly invoice for contractor hours. Deliver the completed invoice to the PC Team Lead for review and approval in a timely manner.
* **Process Improvement:** Collaborate with the PC Team Lead and Enrollment Operations Manager to identify opportunities for, and actively contribute to, the development and implementation of process improvements within the PC department.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a call center environment, with at least 1 year in a within the healthcare or clinical research industry patient-facing screening role.
* Prior supervisory, coaching, or team lead experience strongly preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex medical information clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver constructive feedback in a professional, empathetic, and results-oriented manner.
* Proficiency in remote communication and productivity tools including RingCentral, Slack, and Microsoft Office Suite.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize workload, and manage competing responsibilities in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.

Finance & Operations Manager

$70,000 to $90,000 + performance bonus + equity + healthcare stipend

**About E4C5**

E4C5 is a founder-led boutique agency that applies product management discipline to digital marketing. We partner with B2B SaaS companies, cybersecurity firms, and high-growth technology businesses to drive measurable growth through AI search, SEO, CRO, and paid media.

Our roster includes venture-backed security startups and fast-growing SaaS companies that rely on us as embedded strategic partners. Our MRR has doubled over the last 6 months and our client book has grown 300% over the course of '26. We're bringing on a foundational leader to own the back of the house as we scale.

**The Role**

You'll be our first dedicated leader for the back of house: finance, HR and people operations, compliance, contracts, and the systems that hold the company together. You'll report directly to the founder and CEO. There's no finance or HR expert above you, so you'll own the function, design how it works, and tell us what we should be doing.

We don't expect anyone to be an expert in all of it. You might bring deep accounting experience and less HR, or strong HR, contracts, and compliance experience and less core accounting. What matters is that you're excellent at one or more of these areas, curious about the adjacent ones, and excited to close the gaps as we grow.

This role is built to grow. As E4C5 scales, you'll have a clear path to leading finance and operations for the company.

**What You'll Do**

First 90 days: get the foundation right

Some of this work is unglamorous, and it's the work that keeps a growing company safe.

* Keep us compliant across states, including payroll tax and unemployment registrations, workers' comp, business insurance, licensing, and entity filings.
* Own invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections so cash comes in on time.
* Manage accounts payable, contractor payments, and vendor relationships.
* Run payroll and benefits administration, plus onboarding and offboarding from offer letter to system access.
* Run the monthly close, delivering accurate P&L, cash flow, and MRR reporting.
* Reconcile billable hours and client spend against contracts and invoices so nothing is over- or under-billed.

As you grow: help shape the business

* Build financial models, projections, and headwind and tailwind forecasts for the CEO.
* Partner with the CEO and Head of Delivery on pricing: what we should charge, where margins are thin, and when scope needs to change.
* Lead annual budgeting and help support our 2027 planning.
* Track utilization, effective billable rates, and margins by client and service line.
* Flag financial risks early, from client concentration to contractor costs and margin erosion.
* Own contract administration and renewal tracking, and bring in outside counsel when legal judgment is needed.

**What You'll Get to Build**

You'll design the architecture of our back office, not inherit someone else's. That includes our payroll platform, whether we use a PEO, our benefits program, our finance and HR tool stack, how we run the monthly close, and how we budget each year.

You'll bring recommendations, align with the CEO on the big decisions, and then own the implementation. We expect you to use AI and automation to make recurring work faster and more consistent, with the judgment to check the output when accuracy matters.

**What We're Looking For**

Must-haves

* Deep, hands-on strength in at least one of these: finance and accounting, HR and people operations, or contracts and compliance, ideally in a small business, agency, consultancy, or other services business.
* Working knowledge of QuickBooks and a payroll platform like Gusto, or the ability to get there quickly.
* Strong judgment about when to handle something yourself and when to bring in outside experts.
* The ability to translate accounting, legal, and compliance details into plain-language recommendations for the CEO.
* Highly organized and discreet with sensitive information.

Strong pluses

* Five or more years of relevant experience.
* Agency or retainer-based billing and time tracking.
* Multi-state employment compliance for a remote team.
* Experience using AI and automation to cut manual work out of finance, HR, or operations.

**Who you are**

You're ambitious, low ego, and act like an owner. You bring problems forward early, along with a recommendation for how to solve them. You enjoy a wide range of work, you like learning the parts of the job that are new to you, and you're energized by a lot of autonomy.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within 90 days: We're compliant in every state where we have employees. Invoicing and collections run on a predictable schedule, the monthly close is clean and on time, and the CEO has a clear view of cash, revenue, and profitability without having to ask.

Longer term: You're helping shape how the business grows, not just tracking it. You're advising on pricing, hiring, margins, and investment decisions, you've built a back office that scales, and you're leading finance and operations as the company grows.

**Why This Role**

* Real ownership from day one. You'll lead a function, not take orders, and you'll have a major say in how the company runs.
* Direct access to the founder. You report only to the CEO, with no layers in between and no one micromanaging your area.
* Controls you design. We want lightweight, sensible processes, and you'll be the one to build them.
* Breadth. You'll see finance, people, legal, revenue operations, and planning up close at a fast-growing company.
* A path to leadership. As we scale, this role grows into leading finance and operations.
* Eligibility for our phantom equity plan, which is currently being formalized.
* Fully remote work with flexible hours.

As an integral member of the Client-Based Laboratory (CBL) infrastructure, the CBL Project Manager manages the building of the CBL business anywhere they are needed. More specifically, the CBL Project Manager will travel to new CBL sites to manage and support the management of the CBLs through the Transition and Steady-State phases. With an estimated 90-120 day period for each Transition phase, the CBL Project Manager can expect to be assigned to approximately three to four CBLs per year, depending upon the unique challenges and complexity of each CBL

Responsibilities:

**Summary of Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Transition Phase (usually 90-120 days)

While permanent staff are being hired and onboarded, this position will serve as a member of the QuickStart Team to immediately begin work for the new CBL client.

At the immediate startup of a CBL, the CBL Project Manager will triage the incoming work to determine whether the instrument will be calibrated at the CBL, sent to another Transcat lab, or sent to an approved supplier. They will also perform calibrations through direct calibration of the instruments at the CBL or by performing the review of vendor calibration certs to complete those work orders. As the permanent technician(s) for the CBL are hired, onboarded, and ramp up their calibration duties, the CBL Project Managers will ramp down their direct calibration work and start training and supervising the permanent calibration technicians’ work. Over the course of each Transition Phase, the Project Manager’s calibration tasks start at 100% of their time and reduce to less than 10% over the Phase. In any given year, the calibration tasks equate to about one-third of a Project Manager’s time.

Steady-State Phase

Once the CBL reaches Steady-State, the Project Manager will perform data reviews of technicians’ work across multiple CBLs, remotely, to assist the Calibration Operations Managers with that supervisory function.

In addition, during the Steady-State phase, the Project Manager will move on to the next CBL startup (a Transition Phase at a new CBL), while still performing data reviews of the technicians’ work across multiple CBLs. In addition, whenever technician turnover occurs at a CBL, the Project Manager will also fill in to complete the calibration work, ramping down as the replacement technician is hired/onboarded as described above.

Amoskeag Health is seeking a Revenue Specialist – Quality Assurance to provide workflow support and quality oversight for patient accounting and billing operations. This position monitors revenue cycle activity, analyzes denials and A/R trends, identifies opportunities for improvement, and ensures accuracy across billing, claims, and payment processes. Working closely with the Revenue Cycle Manager and other departments, this role supports quality reviews, staff training, and process improvements to promote accurate and timely reimbursement.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead daily revenue cycle workflows, coordinate work queues and coverage, prioritize time-sensitive accounts, and serve as a resource for complex billing and denial issues. Escalate policy, staffing, and approval decisions to the Revenue Cycle Manager. Assist with Payer Enrollment when needed.

* Coordinate a recurring quality assurance review process for registration, charge capture, claims, payment posting, adjustments, and follow-up. Use documented review criteria and sampling methods, summarize process-level error trends, and track corrective actions and repeat reviews to confirm improvement.

* Maintain current billing procedures, quality checklists, and workflow reference materials. Provide onboarding, cross-training, and process education; communicate approved payer and system updates to promote consistent practices.

* Review daily reconciliation of charges, adjustments, and payments; investigate missing, duplicate, or inconsistent transactions. Coordinate resolution with billing, finance, and other responsible departments within established approval limits.

* Analyze revenue activity, charges, collections, contractual adjustments, and payment variances by payer and service. Compare period-over-period results and established targets, validate source data, and prepare reports explaining trends, potential underpayments, and opportunities to reduce revenue leakage.

* Support accurate posting of Medicare, Medicaid, Blue Cross/Blue Shield, commercial, and other third-party payments and denials. Review unpaid claims within 45 days or sooner when required by payer deadlines; coordinate corrected claims, appeals, and follow-up, and retain supporting documentation.

* Act as a designated liaison with payer and managed care representatives to resolve recurring claim, reimbursement, and enrollment issues. Monitor membership additions and deletions and communicate discrepancies affecting billing.

* Partner with registration, clinical, coding, finance, and information technology teams to strengthen EMR data integrity and documentation-to-billing workflows. Identify missing encounters, charge discrepancies, duplicate records, and interface issues; route corrections to authorized personnel and support testing and validation of system changes without independently altering clinical documentation.

* Prepare recurring revenue cycle and quality dashboards covering A/R aging, denial and rejection trends, clean claims, payment accuracy, and corrective action status. Present findings and recommendations to the Revenue Cycle Manager, coordinate approved process improvements, and monitor results using consistent metric definitions.

* Protect patient and financial information, follow applicable privacy and security requirements and organizational policies, and promptly escalate suspected billing inaccuracies or compliance concerns. Apply established authorization requirements for adjustments, refunds, and account corrections.

* Interact with clients in a positive and professional manner; sensitive in approach to discussions with clients regarding financial matters.

* Support the goals and mission of Amoskeag Health.

* Actively attend and participate in Health Center meetings, as directed. If absent, responsible for reading minutes of meetings and signing the documentation.

* Responsible for the collection of bad debt.

  

**What You'll Bring:**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

* Medical billing and coding certifications preferred

* A minimum of three (3) years of experience in healthcare billing and revenue cycle experience required, including hands-on work with A/R follow-up, denial resolution, payment posting, and reconciliation. Demonstrated experience analyzing revenue and A/R trends and conducting billing quality reviews required.

* Prior workflow coordination, staff training, or quality improvement experience preferred

  

**What We Offer:**

* This position is 40 hours per week, remote (M-F 8a-5p)
* Benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, 403B with Company Match, PTO, Life Insurance, Continuing Education Opportunities and more!
* Work in a supportive, collaborative environment with a team dedicated to advancing Amoskeag Health’s mission.
