jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Technical)
jobs.description:
**Position Tile: Senior Project Manager – Commercial Data Products**

**Position Location: Remote**

**Position Duration: 6 Months Contract to Hire**

**Important:**

This role requires permanent daily collaboration with the India team, typically **6:30–9:00 AM ET, Monday–Friday**.

**The Role**

Our client sells data as a product. Every commercial release—from refreshed company files and new attributes to APIs and client-specific deliveries—depends on reliable data pipelines, entity resolution, and quality controls across U.S. and India engineering teams.

We are looking for a **Project Manager with strong data-product delivery experience** to own commercial delivery from client commitment through engineering, QA, validation, and release.

This is a **delivery-focused role grounded in data systems**, not a general scheduling position. You should understand data pipelines, data quality, warehouses, and client data requirements well enough to facilitate technical discussions and translate requirements into clear Jira work.

A key priority will be transforming the current meeting-heavy process into a **structured, Jira-driven and async-first delivery model**. You will take ownership of the daily standup currently run by the CEO, reduce it to **30 minutes or less**, move problem-solving into focused breakouts, and use Jira and written updates to eliminate unnecessary meetings.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Delivery Management:** Own commercial data releases—including bulk files, APIs, and client-specific extracts—from requirements through QA and delivery.
* **Jira & Confluence:** Restructure Jira as the single system of record across engineering, QA, applications, and commercial delivery. Establish workflows, issue types, boards, ticket standards, dashboards, and adoption practices.
* **Standup & Async Delivery:** Take over the daily standup, reduce meeting time, establish clear agendas and written updates, and shift routine discussions and status reporting to asynchronous workflows.
* **Requirement Translation:** Convert client, sales, and product requirements into scoped Jira epics/stories with acceptance criteria tied to data outcomes such as coverage, fill rate, match rate, freshness, and schema.
* **India Team Facilitation:** Run daily India-hours calls and ensure every cross-time-zone handoff includes clear context, ownership, and deadlines.
* **Quality & Release Gates:** Partner with engineering and QA on validation, regression testing, defect triage, and documented release approvals.
* **Client Commitments:** Maintain the commercial delivery calendar covering refreshes, SLAs, and contractual commitments; identify and escalate risks before deadlines are missed.
* **Dependencies:** Manage dependencies across pipelines, dbt, BigQuery, entity resolution, and shared platform work, recommending trade-offs when conflicts arise.
* **Documentation & Reporting:** Maintain concise Jira/Confluence documentation, decision logs, release notes, and consistent weekly leadership reporting.

**Required Qualifications**

* **8+ years** of project/program management experience, including **3+ years delivering data products, data platforms, or data engineering programs**.
* Strong understanding of **data pipelines, data warehouses, data quality, and data delivery** sufficient to work effectively with engineers.
* Experience managing **data as a product**, including versioned releases, data contracts/SLAs, and delivery through files, APIs, or data-sharing platforms.
* **2+ years managing offshore teams in India**, including recurring India-hours calls and cross-time-zone handoffs.
* Hands-on **Jira and Confluence administration**, including project setup, workflows, issue types, boards, dashboards, and process adoption.
* Proven ability to restructure Jira and establish consistent team usage.
* Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear status reports, scope documents, decisions, and release notes without requiring verbal explanation.
* Strong ability to turn ambiguous requirements into **clear, actionable engineering work**.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a **data provider, data-licensing company, or organization selling data products** to external customers.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or SAFe certification.
* Familiarity with **entity resolution, record linkage, or master data management**.
* Exposure to government/public-sector data programs.
* Experience in a **founder-led or high-growth environment** where delivery processes had to be built and improved.

**Success in the First 90 Days**

* Daily standup operates **without CEO involvement** and consistently finishes within 30 minutes.
* Jira becomes the **single source of truth**, with every active item having an owner, due date, and current status.
* Commercial delivery commitments and product releases are visible through a single delivery calendar.
* India team calls run with clear agendas, decisions, owners, and action items.
* At least one recurring data-product refresh ships using documented QA and release criteria.
* Leadership receives consistent weekly delivery reporting without needing follow-up clarification.
* **Meeting volume decreases materially**, with routine status, decisions, and follow-ups handled asynchronously through Jira and written documentation.

Pay: $70.00 - $75.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Account Manager**  
REMOTE | US

**About Us**

Property Leads delivers high-quality, motivated seller leads to real estate investors, and we're expanding into home services. We're a quiet but mighty start-up that participated in 50% of off-market home sales in the last 12 months. We move fast, we're data-driven, and we care about results.

Our customers are real estate investors and roofers/roofing companies running real businesses on our leads. When something breaks for them, it matters, and fixing it fast is how we grow. If you want to check the box on responding to a ticket without solving the problem, this isn't the place. If you want to own real customer relationships and get on the phone to solve real problems, it is.

**Role**

Once Sales converts a prospect into a customer, you own the account for its lifetime: you build the relationship, keep them buying, and grow what they spend. Retention, expansion, and goodwill are your job, and your book of business is your number.

**Responsibilities**

* Take the handoff from Sales at go-live, run onboarding, and get each customer to early results fast.
* Monitor account health (purchase frequency, lead quality feedback, support history, payment activity) and reach out before customers go quiet.
* Build goodwill by responding fast, telling customers the truth, following through, and advocating for them internally.
* Grow accounts through new markets and increased budget once the customer's core concerns are resolved.
* When an account is at risk, overcome their objections and redirect them back to their original goal.
* Log every customer conversation, risk, and outcome in the CRM.

**Requirements**

* 3–5+ years owning a book of B2B accounts, with a measurable record of keeping customers and growing their spend. You should be able to tell us your retention rate and how much expansion revenue you closed.
* Experience owning a book of business and building genuine relationships with your book.
* Strong negotiation, objection handling, and de-escalation skills.
* Comfortable in a CRM and managing a pipeline.
* Nice to have: lead-gen or other repeat-purchase experience; real estate investor, roofer, or very small-business customers; experience as a real estate investor/agent or roofer.

**Results**

* Retention: When a customer requests to cancel, you overcome their objections to keep them spending.
* Expansion: You encourage the customers who are spending to spend more (increase budget, add more markets)
* Goodwill: You build and maintain relationships with every customer in your book of business. Gather testimonials and get them to refer others to Property Leads.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base Salary: $50,000 per year

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Program Coordinator leads day-to-day planning, implementation, and documentation of Eden Youth’s integrated youth substance use prevention portfolio, including scheduling and partnerships with districts and school sites. Current programs include Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, Stanford REACH Lab prevention curricula (such as Smart Talk, opioid/fentanyl awareness, Our Healthy Futures, and age-appropriate vape-free education), and the Familia Adelante curriculum and family workshops. The Coordinator aligns program delivery with school calendars, grant requirements, evaluation protocols, and the Senior Program Manager’s priorities, and incorporates youth voice throughout. The position also supervises, trains, and coaches facilitators and peer educators. This is a prevention role; it does not provide substance use disorder diagnosis or clinical treatment.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**School partnerships and implementation**

Serve as the primary liaison between schools, districts, staff, and community partners to coordinate program planning, approvals, scheduling, referrals, and implementation. Ensure culturally responsive, age-appropriate, and accessible services across middle and high schools, including seasonal programming. Maintain site trackers to monitor attendance, program delivery, evaluations, staffing, challenges, and follow-up actions while supporting partnership agreements and renewals.

**Stanford REACH Lab curricula and appropriate intervention**

Coordinate the effective delivery of Stanford REACH Lab substance-use prevention curricula, including cannabis, vaping, opioid/fentanyl awareness, and alternatives to suspension. Schedule and support trained educators, monitor curriculum fidelity, and address implementation concerns. Collaborate with school teams to manage referrals, ensure confidential student support, and coordinate pre/post-surveys using approved Stanford data collection tools.

**Friday Night Live and youth leadership**

Coordinate Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, youth leadership meetings, prevention campaigns, and school activities while promoting youth participation and ownership. Collaborate with the Youth Advisory Council (YAC) on youth-led projects, community outreach, and advocacy. Train and mentor youth leaders in communication, project planning, inclusive leadership, prevention messaging, and responsible reporting.

**Familia Adelante and caregiver engagement**

Coordinate culturally responsive Familia Adelante workshops and caregiver education in partnership with schools, families, and bilingual facilitators. Manage outreach, scheduling, translation and interpretation, registration, attendance, and follow-up while maintaining confidentiality. Ensure county-funded program requirements are met and documented separately from other funded activities.

**Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Health Connections**

Introduce ECM and Community Connect services to school counselors, family engagement staff, and student support teams. Identify potential referral opportunities for students and families experiencing complex health or social needs. Coordinate referrals to staff for Medi-Cal and CYBHI eligibility verification, assessment, and enrollment determination. Support connections to behavioral health services, and other community programs. Follow up on referral coordination while maintaining confidentiality and respecting family consent.

**Deliverables, evaluation, and contract compliance**

Maintain funder-specific work plans, documentation, and reporting to ensure contract compliance and prevent duplicate billing or reporting. Coordinate accurate data collection, timely submissions, evaluations, and quality assurance. Support county reporting deadlines, annual prevention planning, stakeholder feedback, and continuous program improvement. Collaborate with management and partners to fulfill prevention and youth engagement deliverables.

**Team coordination, safety, and professionalism**

Provide guidance, onboarding, and coaching to peer educators, youth specialists, and interns while collaborating with supervisors to support team development, staffing needs, and program effectiveness. Ensure compliance with mandated reporting, youth safety, district policies, confidentiality, and trauma-informed practices. Participate in required professional development to maintain program quality and professionalism.

**QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)**

Strong organizational, coordination, and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple school sites, and concurrent program deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with students, families, school personnel, staff, and community partners.

Exercises sound judgment, makes well-reasoned decisions, and develops practical solutions to operational and program-related challenges.

Demonstrates adaptability, embraces responsible organizational change, and supports continuous improvement in alignment with the organization's mission.

Maintains a results-oriented approach, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets established deadlines and performance expectations.

Demonstrates active listening, cultural humility, and respect for diverse perspectives while modeling inclusive and professional behavior.

Demonstrates accountability, ethical conduct, professionalism, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Required Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with at least two years coordinating youth, school-based, prevention, or community programs.

Strong organizational, communication, relationship-building, and culturally responsive facilitation skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft 365, data tracking, and reporting systems.

new_jobs.title: Office Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Bonsai Robotics**

Bonsai Robotics develops affordable, vision-based autonomy that makes off-road equipment smarter, safer, and more productive. We are redefining outdoor autonomy with Bonsai Intelligence, a connected platform that’s inspired by biology to see, think, and act with precision like a human. We bring together advanced perception, embodied AI, integrations with equipment manufacturers, and our compact, modular Amiga vehicles to deliver reliable automation to the world’s most demanding field operations—reducing costs and increasing operational efficiencies.

**About the role**

We’re looking for an Office Manager to keep our San Jose and Watsonville offices running smoothly. You’ll be the go-to person for everything that makes the workplace work, from facilities and vendors to supplies, mail, and the day-to-day details that help our team stay focused on building robots.

This role splits time between both offices. You’ll own internal office projects from start to finish, support our real estate needs as we grow, and provide hands-on support to our leadership team. It’s a great fit for someone who is organized, resourceful, and enjoys building structure in a fast-moving startup.

**What you'll do**

* Manage day-to-day operations for our San Jose and Watsonville offices, including facilities, maintenance, vendors, badge access, and office equipment
* Lead internal office projects like space planning, moves, buildouts, and workplace improvements, from scoping through completion
* Support real estate needs, including lease administration, landlord communication, and coordination with brokers
* Order and stock snacks, beverages, and supplies for both offices, and manage related budgets and vendor relationships
* Open, scan, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and manage outgoing shipments
* Provide executive support, including calendar coordination, meeting logistics, and ad hoc projects
* Coordinate company wide events, on-site meetings, visitor check-in, and in-office lunches
* Travel regularly between the San Jose and Watsonville offices to keep both sites running consistently

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in office management, facilities, or administrative operations, ideally at a startup or tech company
* Experience supporting multiple office locations or a distributed team
* Exposure to real estate, lease administration, or facilities projects is a plus
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping details
* Clear, professional communicator who’s comfortable working with executives, vendors, and landlords
* Proficient with Google Workspace and quick to pick up new tools
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for regular travel between San Jose and Watsonville
* Self-starter who takes ownership and brings a positive, service-minded approach

**Life at Bonsai Robotics**

At Bonsai, we're building the future of robotics and we know that means investing in our people. We're committed to creating a workplace where you can do your best work, grow your skills, and feel genuinely part of something bigger.

**Hybrid Flexibility (for selective roles)**

We operate on a hybrid model because we believe the best collaboration happens both in person and from where you work best. You'll have the flexibility to split your time between our office and home, so you can stay connected to the team while maintaining the balance that works for you.

**Work-life Balance**

The best employees are those who create balance in their lives, which is why we prioritize balance and well-being for everyone at Bonsai. We foster a supportive environment where teammates look out for each other.

**Covered Lunch**

On in-office days, we've got lunch covered. It's a small thing that makes a big difference, with more time to connect with teammates and less to worry about.

**Wellness and Benefits**

Your health matters. We offer comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), mental health support, and wellness programs designed to help you thrive both physically and mentally.

**Collaborative Culture**

At Bonsai, you're not just part of a team, you're part of a community. We celebrate wins together, support each other through challenges, and genuinely enjoy the people we work with. From team events to cross-functional collaboration, we're building something together.

**Mission-driven Work**

Every day, you're contributing to advancements in robotics that matter. If you're excited about innovation and impact, you'll find it here.

Bonsai Robotics is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 75,000 USD per year(San Jose)

Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

Responsibilities
  
  
The Global Business Marketing (GBM) team champions TikTok in the B2B landscape, showing advertisers and sales teams how TikTok's creative ecosystem drives real business results. We build the stories, education, and go-to-market programs that sellers use to deepen client relationships across markets. Working with brands of all sizes, we also bring campaigns to life through creative ideation, brand and event strategy, and the design and production of TikTok for Business marketing, so advertisers can create content that connect with audiences. Trends, consumer behavior, and advertising formats all move quickly on TikTok. The challenge is turning what makes the platform engaging into solutions that are creative, measurable, and scalable across very different markets, without making the experience feel like traditional advertising. You will shape how the market understands TikTok as a business platform, and help brands show up authentically on it. Our Product MarComs (PMC) & Industry Enablement (IE) sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Data and Customer Experience. We build the knowledge, education, intelligence and measurement capabilities that help turn product innovation and marketing interventions into measurable customer and business outcomes. Our work spans customer and seller experiences including the Business Resource Center, in-product education, sales enablement and AI-powered education experiences. As these experiences become increasingly connected, our measurement approach must evolve as well—from measuring individual programs and channels to understanding how knowledge, education and marketing interventions influence customer behavior across the journey. We are building a measurement and experimentation capability that connects customer engagement to activation, product adoption, expansion and business growth. We're seeking an experienced Program Manager, Measurement & Experimentation to build the measurement foundation that enables data-driven decision making across product knowledge, education and customer enablement experiences. Today, customer and seller interactions occur across multiple surfaces and systems. Traffic, engagement, learning activity, AI interactions, product behavior and commercial outcomes are often measured independently, making it difficult to understand the complete customer journey or determine which interventions actually drive behavior. This role will help change that. Responsibilities Build a Connected Measurement Architecture - Develop scalable measurement frameworks to evaluate the business impact of product knowledge, education, and enablement initiatives across the customer journey. - Define standardized metrics, event taxonomies, and measurement requirements across reach, engagement, learning, activation, product adoption, and commercial outcomes. - Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to integrate data across systems, improve measurement capabilities, and connect customer engagement to downstream business outcomes. Connect Engagement to Business Outcomes - Develop measurement frameworks that connect customer and seller engagement to measurable behavioral and business outcomes beyond traditional engagement metrics. - Define leading and lagging indicators to assess the impact of knowledge and education initiatives on activation, product adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue. - Establish attribution and measurement approaches to evaluate the effectiveness and business contribution of educational experiences and platforms, such as TikTok Academy and Business Help Center. Build an Experimentation Capability - Establish scalable experimentation standards and playbooks across knowledge, education, and customer enablement programs. - Partner with Product, Marketing, and Data Science teams to design and evaluate experiments using clear hypotheses, success metrics, and appropriate testing methodologies. - Translate experimental insights into actionable recommendations to optimize customer behavior, product experiences, content, and engagement strategies. Develop Holistic Reporting & Decision Systems - Develop scalable reporting frameworks, datasets, and dashboards that provide end-to-end visibility across the customer journey and business outcomes. - Create executive-level insights, performance benchmarks, and automated monitoring to identify trends, gaps, and optimization opportunities. - Partner with Analytics and Data Engineering teams to translate data into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and continuous improvement. Enable Customer and Knowledge Intelligence - Leverage behavioral data across customer interactions, learning, AI experiences, and product usage to identify knowledge gaps and adoption barriers. - Partner with cross-functional teams to identify customer friction and determine effective interventions across audiences, products, and journey stages. - Establish continuous feedback loops that translate measurement insights into actionable improvements for knowledge, education, customer adoption, and GTM strategies. Connect Measurement to GBM Objectives Develop measurement approaches that demonstrate how our capabilities contribute to GBM priorities including: - New Client Acquisition: qualification, onboarding, activation and time to first meaningful action. - Client Expansion: adoption of additional products and capabilities, engagement and growth. - Product Growth: product awareness → understanding → activation → sustained adoption. - Market Positioning: reach, engagement and behavioral signals associated with strategic narratives and education. - Commercial Marketing Excellence: measurement consistency, automation, experimentation and decision quality.

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

You will be the second person on Revenue Operations, reporting directly to the Director of RevOps and working as his right hand. RevOps at Outset owns the full go-to-market stack and the numbers that run the business: Salesforce, HubSpot, routing, automations, ARR reporting, quota and comp tracking, sales process and policy. Today one person runs all of it, with AI tools doing a lot of the heavy lifting. Your job is to take real ownership of a growing share of that scope, fast.  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
*Systems and CRM*

* Administer Salesforce day to day: fields, record types, page layouts, permission sets, validation rules, flows, reports and dashboards.
* Keep the HubSpot Salesforce sync healthy, debug field and picklist mismatches, and own lead-to-opportunity data integrity.
* Maintain and extend our sales tool stack: Apollo, Momentum (call recording), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, meeting routing, Linear, Slack bots.
* Run user provisioning, onboarding and offboarding across the stack, and keep the integration users and connections tidy.

*Automation and AI*

* Build and maintain workflows in n8n that connect Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Linear and Google Workspace.
* Use Claude and other AI tools as a default working style: drafting SOQL and flows, writing runbooks, summarizing calls, prepping handover docs, pressure-testing analyses.
* Spot manual, repetitive work on the GTM team and remove it.

*Analytics and reporting*

* Own recurring reporting: weekly revenue breakouts, pipeline and stage hygiene, AE quota attainment and ramp, win/loss by segment and competitor.
* Keep ARR truth clean: reconcile ARR by contract, maintain customer and account-status definitions in Salesforce, and make sure nothing is double counted.
* Build dashboards leadership actually uses, in Salesforce, Google Sheets, or whatever tool fits, and be able to explain every number on them.
* Answer ad hoc questions from the CRO, finance and the board with fast, correct, well-caveated analysis.

*Sales process and enablement*

* Run pipeline hygiene: stale-opportunity nudges, stage definitions, close-date discipline, the Sales CS handover.
* Help draft and roll out sales policy such as Rules of Engagement, territory and lead routing, and comp plan mechanics, then enforce them in the system.
* Support deal desk work: order forms, pricing and discount checks, contract term extraction into Salesforce.
* Be the first call for AEs and SDRs when something in the stack is broken or confusing, and fix it or teach it.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or an adjacent seat at a B2B SaaS company (sales ops analyst, SDR or AE who moved into ops, BizOps, CS ops).
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: you have built reports and dashboards, edited fields and layouts, and ideally written a flow or two. Admin certification is a plus, not a requirement.
* Working knowledge of a B2B sales motion end to end: lead sources, SDR qualification, stages, pilots and POCs, closed-won, renewals and expansion. You understand what an AE’s week looks like and what makes their life harder.
* AI tools as a native part of how you work. You already use Claude, ChatGPT or similar to write queries, draft documents, debug formulas and think through problems, and you can tell when the output is wrong.
* Strong spreadsheet and data skills: lookups, pivots, clean data models, and the judgment to know when a number does not smell right.
* Clear written communication. A lot of this job is explaining a system, a policy or a number to a salesperson in a Slack message.

**Nice to have**

* HubSpot (marketing hub or CRM) and experience with a HubSpot Salesforce sync.
* Time carrying a quota, or sitting next to people who do.
* Experience with deal desk, order forms or contract review.
* Exposure to ARR accounting concepts: new, expansion, contraction, churn, contracted vs. invoiced.
* Scrappy and resourceful: you would rather ship a good-enough fix today and improve it next week than wait for a perfect spec.
* A jack of all trades who is happy to go from a permission-set bug to a board-deck chart to a rep’s comp question in the same afternoon.
* Eager to learn and quick to pick things up; you ask good questions, take notes, and do not need to be told twice.
* High ownership. When something is yours, it gets done and it gets done right.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and with being the one who brings structure to it.

Compensation Range: $125K - $150K

new_jobs.title: Patient Coordinator Support Lead
new_jobs.description:
**About 1nHealth, Inc.**  
1nHealth is a software-centric patient recruitment company for the clinical research industry. We exist to fill studies, connecting patients with research. We have been active for 6 years as a bootstrapped startup that now has 45 employees and multiple clients in top Pharma, leading biotechnology companies, and many of the top Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in the space. Our mission is to advance human health and make a positive impact on patients, clients, and our team members all over the world.

We are growing and profitable. Our company is a client and employee centric meritocracy. If you're ready to be part of a team of highly intelligent professionals using technology for good, come join us at 1nHealth.

**About the role**

The Patient Coordinator (PC) Support Lead is a senior individual contributor role that combines the full responsibilities of a Patient Coordinator with a leadership layer: overseeing, coaching, and managing the performance of 1nHealth's contractor (vendor) PC team. This role is ideal for an experienced Patient Coordinator who demonstrates strong clinical knowledge, communication excellence, and the desire to develop and elevate others.

The PC Support Lead plays a critical dual role — remaining an active contributor in the pre-screening process while ensuring the contractor PC team meets quality standards, performance metrics, and compliance requirements.

**Duties and Responsibilities**  
  
**Patient Coordinator Duties**

* **Pre-Screening Calls:** Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls. Conduct thorough pre-screening calls with potential candidates remotely to gather medical history, demographics, and other relevant information as per trial protocols.
* **Patient Interaction:** Communicate clearly and compassionately with potential participants, explaining the purpose of clinical trials, eligibility criteria, and associated risks or benefits. Forge relationships with patients by going the extra mile.
* **Medical Terminology:** Demonstrate proficiency in medical terminology to accurately assess patient information and determine eligibility for clinical trials.
* **Technical Skills:** Utilize remote communication tools including Microsoft Outlook, SharePoint, RingCentral, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and other relevant software for conducting calls, documentation, and team communication.
* **Performance Metrics:** Meet or exceed KPIs related to pre-qualified referrals and downstream funnel outcomes such as enrollment rates and conversion ratios.
* **Documentation:** Maintain detailed and accurate records of patient interactions using remote documentation tools, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and trial-specific requirements.
* **Quality Assurance:** Adhere to established quality assurance protocols to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and trial-specific requirements.
* **Training and Development:** Participate in ongoing remote training sessions to stay updated on trial protocols, regulatory requirements, and best practices in patient engagement.
* **Communication:** Provide timely updates to relevant stakeholders regarding patient status, referral outcomes, and any issues or concerns that may arise during the pre-screening process.

**Contractor Team Oversight & Coaching**

* **Call Quality Review (QA):** Regularly review recorded calls from contractor PCs to evaluate adherence to scripts, regulatory requirements, and 1nHealth quality standards. Document findings and use them to inform coaching sessions.
* **KPI Dashboard Review:** Monitor the PC KPI dashboard on an ongoing basis to assess individual and team-level performance metrics. Proactively identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement across the contractor team.
* **Coaching & Feedback Delivery:** Provide structured, constructive coaching to each direct report on the contractor PC team, including:
* Delivering meaningful, individualized feedback to each direct report a minimum of twice per month.
* Escalating unresolved performance concerns to the PC Team Lead when coaching alone does not produce the necessary improvement.
* **Performance-Based Bonus Recommendations:** Evaluate contractor PC performance data and provide informed recommendations to the PC Team Lead regarding which team members should be considered for performance-based bonuses.
* **Timesheet Approval:** Review and approve contractor PC timesheets on a weekly basis, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* **Monthly Invoice Generation:** Compile and generate the monthly invoice for contractor hours. Deliver the completed invoice to the PC Team Lead for review and approval in a timely manner.
* **Process Improvement:** Collaborate with the PC Team Lead and Enrollment Operations Manager to identify opportunities for, and actively contribute to, the development and implementation of process improvements within the PC department.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a call center environment, with at least 1 year in a within the healthcare or clinical research industry patient-facing screening role.
* Prior supervisory, coaching, or team lead experience strongly preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex medical information clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver constructive feedback in a professional, empathetic, and results-oriented manner.
* Proficiency in remote communication and productivity tools including RingCentral, Slack, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Solid knowledge of medical terminology and clinical trial processes.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize workload, and manage competing responsibilities in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and comfort with data-driven performance management.
* GCP (Good Clinical Practice) certification or willingness to obtain certification within a specified timeframe.

The successful candidate will use workforce data, forecasting, and operational insights to identify staffing gaps, improve caregiver utilization, strengthen the connection between recruiting and staffing needs, and build scalable processes that support continued growth.

This is a fully remote position operating primarily during East Coast business hours.

Success in this role will be measured by reductions in open client hours and unmet service needs, improved staffing efficiency and caregiver utilization, stronger alignment between workforce supply and client demand, and consistent execution of staffing processes across markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Staffing Liaisons responsible for matching caregivers with client needs and supporting continuity of services across multiple states.

* Drive workforce planning, capacity management, and staffing optimization strategies to maximize caregiver availability and utilization while reducing open client hours.

* Analyze staffing, recruiting, workforce, and service data to identify trends, capacity gaps, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

* Develop and monitor workforce KPIs, dashboards, forecasts, and performance reporting to support data-driven decision-making.

* Translate client staffing demand into actionable workforce and recruiting needs, helping ensure caregiver supply is aligned with current and anticipated service needs.

* Monitor staffing performance and implement action plans to improve coverage, responsiveness, caregiver utilization, and service-level performance.

* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability measures for the Staffing Liaison team.

* Identify process inefficiencies and lead operational improvement initiatives that increase productivity, consistency, scalability, and service delivery performance.

* Optimize workflows, technology utilization, and workforce management practices across markets.

* Ensure consistent processes, system utilization, and documentation standards across regions.

* Support strategic initiatives related to organizational growth, workforce planning, capacity forecasting, recruiting strategy, and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of people leadership experience in healthcare, human services, staffing, recruiting, workforce operations, or another high-volume service environment.

* Demonstrated success leading teams against measurable performance goals, KPIs, and accountability standards.

* Experience with workforce planning, staffing optimization, scheduling, recruiting, capacity management, or workforce deployment.

* Recruiting or talent acquisition experience strongly preferred, particularly in high-volume or difficult-to-fill workforce environments.

* Experience improving workforce utilization, reducing staffing or service gaps, increasing coverage, or improving operational efficiency.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex operational data into clear priorities and actionable strategies.

* Experience developing or managing KPIs, dashboards, forecasts, and performance reporting.

* Strong process-improvement skills with experience identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable operational solutions.

* Proficiency with workforce management systems, scheduling platforms, CRM systems, reporting tools, and other operational technology.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to collaborate across clinical, recruiting, and operational teams.

* Strategic thinker who is equally comfortable analyzing performance data and working hands-on with a team to improve results.

$70,000 to $90,000 + performance bonus + equity + healthcare stipend

**About E4C5**

E4C5 is a founder-led boutique agency that applies product management discipline to digital marketing. We partner with B2B SaaS companies, cybersecurity firms, and high-growth technology businesses to drive measurable growth through AI search, SEO, CRO, and paid media.

Our roster includes venture-backed security startups and fast-growing SaaS companies that rely on us as embedded strategic partners. Our MRR has doubled over the last 6 months and our client book has grown 300% over the course of '26. We're bringing on a foundational leader to own the back of the house as we scale.

**The Role**

You'll be our first dedicated leader for the back of house: finance, HR and people operations, compliance, contracts, and the systems that hold the company together. You'll report directly to the founder and CEO. There's no finance or HR expert above you, so you'll own the function, design how it works, and tell us what we should be doing.

We don't expect anyone to be an expert in all of it. You might bring deep accounting experience and less HR, or strong HR, contracts, and compliance experience and less core accounting. What matters is that you're excellent at one or more of these areas, curious about the adjacent ones, and excited to close the gaps as we grow.

This role is built to grow. As E4C5 scales, you'll have a clear path to leading finance and operations for the company.

**What You'll Do**

First 90 days: get the foundation right

Some of this work is unglamorous, and it's the work that keeps a growing company safe.

* Keep us compliant across states, including payroll tax and unemployment registrations, workers' comp, business insurance, licensing, and entity filings.
* Own invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections so cash comes in on time.
* Manage accounts payable, contractor payments, and vendor relationships.
* Run payroll and benefits administration, plus onboarding and offboarding from offer letter to system access.
* Run the monthly close, delivering accurate P&L, cash flow, and MRR reporting.
* Reconcile billable hours and client spend against contracts and invoices so nothing is over- or under-billed.

As you grow: help shape the business

* Build financial models, projections, and headwind and tailwind forecasts for the CEO.
* Partner with the CEO and Head of Delivery on pricing: what we should charge, where margins are thin, and when scope needs to change.
* Lead annual budgeting and help support our 2027 planning.
* Track utilization, effective billable rates, and margins by client and service line.
* Flag financial risks early, from client concentration to contractor costs and margin erosion.
* Own contract administration and renewal tracking, and bring in outside counsel when legal judgment is needed.

**What You'll Get to Build**

You'll design the architecture of our back office, not inherit someone else's. That includes our payroll platform, whether we use a PEO, our benefits program, our finance and HR tool stack, how we run the monthly close, and how we budget each year.

You'll bring recommendations, align with the CEO on the big decisions, and then own the implementation. We expect you to use AI and automation to make recurring work faster and more consistent, with the judgment to check the output when accuracy matters.

**What We're Looking For**

Must-haves

* Deep, hands-on strength in at least one of these: finance and accounting, HR and people operations, or contracts and compliance, ideally in a small business, agency, consultancy, or other services business.
* Working knowledge of QuickBooks and a payroll platform like Gusto, or the ability to get there quickly.
* Strong judgment about when to handle something yourself and when to bring in outside experts.
* The ability to translate accounting, legal, and compliance details into plain-language recommendations for the CEO.
* Highly organized and discreet with sensitive information.

Strong pluses

* Five or more years of relevant experience.
* Agency or retainer-based billing and time tracking.
* Multi-state employment compliance for a remote team.
* Experience using AI and automation to cut manual work out of finance, HR, or operations.

**Who you are**

You're ambitious, low ego, and act like an owner. You bring problems forward early, along with a recommendation for how to solve them. You enjoy a wide range of work, you like learning the parts of the job that are new to you, and you're energized by a lot of autonomy.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within 90 days: We're compliant in every state where we have employees. Invoicing and collections run on a predictable schedule, the monthly close is clean and on time, and the CEO has a clear view of cash, revenue, and profitability without having to ask.

Longer term: You're helping shape how the business grows, not just tracking it. You're advising on pricing, hiring, margins, and investment decisions, you've built a back office that scales, and you're leading finance and operations as the company grows.

**Why This Role**

* Real ownership from day one. You'll lead a function, not take orders, and you'll have a major say in how the company runs.
* Direct access to the founder. You report only to the CEO, with no layers in between and no one micromanaging your area.

* A path to leadership. As we scale, this role grows into leading finance and operations.
* Eligibility for our phantom equity plan, which is currently being formalized.
* Fully remote work with flexible hours.

##### **Overview**

This role may be hired at the Manager or Senior Manager level, depending on experience and qualifications, and is responsible for establishing and overseeing BIM/VDC program requirements for owner-driven projects. The role defines program frameworks, sets digital delivery standards, and coordinates across design and construction stakeholders to ensure consistent, predictable digital delivery aligned with owner expectations across projects and phases.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Program Setup & Governance**

* Define program-level BIM/VDC requirements with owners, design teams and contractors.
* Translate owner objectives into clear BIM/VDC program requirements.
* Develop and maintain the Digital Delivery Framework for each program, including standards, expectations, workflows and governance rules.
* Establish documentation standards, naming conventions, file structures, LOD matrix and model audit processes.
* Set up and govern the Common Data Environment (ACC/BIM360) including permissions, workflows, coordination model structure and milestone gates.
* Conduct BIM/VDC discovery and evaluation of existing project conditions.
* Provide clear definitions of 4D/5D integration expectations (rules, inputs, requirements) without performing scheduling or cost modeling work.

**Owner & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for owners on all Digital Delivery Program matters.
* Facilitate alignment between owner objectives, design intent, fabrication needs and field execution requirements.
* Document decisions, requirements and constraints that impact digital delivery.
* Review and validate VDC scope expectations with design partners, trade contractors and owner consultants.
* Coordinate with other third-party BIM/VDC vendors to ensure compliance with program standards.

**Internal Service Line Integration**

* Translate owner/program requirements into actionable scope to be delivered by VEC Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, Civil, Coordination, On-Site QC, Scanning and Implementation teams.
* Participate in internal kickoff, pre-planning and milestone check-ins for all active VEC scopes.
* Verify that each service line is aligned with program standards, workflows and deliverable expectations.
* Identify gap scopes, risk areas, inefficiencies and provide direction for corrective actions.
* Support QA/QC reviews of models, documentation and coordination outputs.

**Program Delivery Management**

* Oversee the execution of all VEC Digital Delivery scopes at the program level.
* Maintain visibility on timeline, risk, resourcing needs, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Track compliance with program-wide standards, workflows, and owner requirements.
* Facilitate periodic program reviews, alignment meetings, and reporting to ownership teams.
* Escalate major risks, design coordination issues, and technical blockers early with recommended solutions.

**Digital Strategy & Technical Direction**

* Define the technology stack required for digital delivery (ACC, scanning, point layout, coordination tools, parameters, metadata structure etc.)
* Support development of digital twin requirements and asset data structures.
* Provide direction on how design data, construction models and field data should connect across the lifecycle.
* Evaluate workflows for constructability, clash avoidance, risk mitigation and early design issue detection.
* Maintain program knowledge base, templates and lessons learned for repeatability.
* Define FM/digital twin deliverable requirements early.

**Documentation, Reporting & Standardization**

**Maintain consistent program documentation including:**

* Digital Delivery Playbook
* BIM Execution Plan Framework
* Program Standards Log
* Issue Logs and Model Audit Reports
* LOD Matrix
* Tech Stack & Core Platforms
* Shared Parameters
* Model Metadata
* 4D/5D Readiness
* Federated Model
* Clash Sequencing

MGT is a leading provider of technology and advisory solutions serving state, local, and education government agencies (SLED) across the United States. Founded in 1975, MGT initiated an ambitious restart in 2016, broadening the solutions portfolio to provide the most specialized solutions, tackling the most mission-critical problems that live at the top of the public agency leadership agenda. MGT drives over 20% compound annual organic growth and utilizes programmatic mergers and acquisitions to grow capabilities, attract top talent, and accelerate growth scale. Since 2020, MGT has successfully completed 13 acquisitions, driving over 60% compound annual inorganic growth.

Celebrating its 50th year in 2025, the firm attracts exceptional talent and empowers them to exceed client expectations as they navigate the dynamic demands of the clients we serve. Hear more about MGT’s culture in the words of our employees (https://www.mgt.us/careers/).

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

The Senior PM independently manages complex, multi-phase projects that may span both Engineering and Cabling solution groups, or technically specialized projects end-to-end. The Senior PM applies professional project management principles, practices, and techniques to lead project teams and control schedule, cost, and scope, while serving as the primary client relationship owner on assigned projects. **Project Planning and Initiation**

May be assigned first-level supervisory or mentoring responsibilities for Project Managers and Project Coordinators, regionally or team-wide; no formal direct reports.

Use documented review criteria and sampling methods, summarize process-level error trends, and track corrective actions and repeat reviews to confirm improvement.

* Maintain current billing procedures, quality checklists, and workflow reference materials. Provide onboarding, cross-training, and process education; communicate approved payer and system updates to promote consistent practices.

Compare period-over-period results and established targets, validate source data, and prepare reports explaining trends, potential underpayments, and opportunities to reduce revenue leakage.

Review unpaid claims within 45 days or sooner when required by payer deadlines; coordinate corrected claims, appeals, and follow-up, and retain supporting documentation.

* Act as a designated liaison with payer and managed care representatives to resolve recurring claim, reimbursement, and enrollment issues. Monitor membership additions and deletions and communicate discrepancies affecting billing.

* Partner with registration, clinical, coding, finance, and information technology teams to strengthen EMR data integrity and documentation-to-billing workflows. * Protect patient and financial information, follow applicable privacy and security requirements and organizational policies, and promptly escalate suspected billing inaccuracies or compliance concerns. Apply established authorization requirements for adjustments, refunds, and account corrections.

* Interact with clients in a positive and professional manner; sensitive in approach to discussions with clients regarding financial matters.

* Support the goals and mission of Amoskeag Health.

* Actively attend and participate in Health Center meetings, as directed. If absent, responsible for reading minutes of meetings and signing the documentation.

* Responsible for the collection of bad debt.

  

**What You'll Bring:**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

* Medical billing and coding certifications preferred

* A minimum of three (3) years of experience in healthcare billing and revenue cycle experience required, including hands-on work with A/R follow-up, denial resolution, payment posting, and reconciliation. Demonstrated experience analyzing revenue and A/R trends and conducting billing quality reviews required.

* Prior workflow coordination, staff training, or quality improvement experience preferred

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Technical)
new_jobs.description:
**Position Tile: Senior Project Manager – Commercial Data Products**

**Position Location: Remote**

**Position Duration: 6 Months Contract to Hire**

**Important:**

This role requires permanent daily collaboration with the India team, typically **6:30–9:00 AM ET, Monday–Friday**.

**The Role**

Our client sells data as a product. Every commercial release—from refreshed company files and new attributes to APIs and client-specific deliveries—depends on reliable data pipelines, entity resolution, and quality controls across U.S. and India engineering teams.

We are looking for a **Project Manager with strong data-product delivery experience** to own commercial delivery from client commitment through engineering, QA, validation, and release.

This is a **delivery-focused role grounded in data systems**, not a general scheduling position. You should understand data pipelines, data quality, warehouses, and client data requirements well enough to facilitate technical discussions and translate requirements into clear Jira work.

A key priority will be transforming the current meeting-heavy process into a **structured, Jira-driven and async-first delivery model**. You will take ownership of the daily standup currently run by the CEO, reduce it to **30 minutes or less**, move problem-solving into focused breakouts, and use Jira and written updates to eliminate unnecessary meetings.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Delivery Management:** Own commercial data releases—including bulk files, APIs, and client-specific extracts—from requirements through QA and delivery.
* **Jira & Confluence:** Restructure Jira as the single system of record across engineering, QA, applications, and commercial delivery. Establish workflows, issue types, boards, ticket standards, dashboards, and adoption practices.
* **Standup & Async Delivery:** Take over the daily standup, reduce meeting time, establish clear agendas and written updates, and shift routine discussions and status reporting to asynchronous workflows.
* **Requirement Translation:** Convert client, sales, and product requirements into scoped Jira epics/stories with acceptance criteria tied to data outcomes such as coverage, fill rate, match rate, freshness, and schema.
* **India Team Facilitation:** Run daily India-hours calls and ensure every cross-time-zone handoff includes clear context, ownership, and deadlines.
* **Quality & Release Gates:** Partner with engineering and QA on validation, regression testing, defect triage, and documented release approvals.
* **Client Commitments:** Maintain the commercial delivery calendar covering refreshes, SLAs, and contractual commitments; identify and escalate risks before deadlines are missed.
* **Dependencies:** Manage dependencies across pipelines, dbt, BigQuery, entity resolution, and shared platform work, recommending trade-offs when conflicts arise.
* **Documentation & Reporting:** Maintain concise Jira/Confluence documentation, decision logs, release notes, and consistent weekly leadership reporting.

**Required Qualifications**

* **8+ years** of project/program management experience, including **3+ years delivering data products, data platforms, or data engineering programs**.
* Strong understanding of **data pipelines, data warehouses, data quality, and data delivery** sufficient to work effectively with engineers.
* Experience managing **data as a product**, including versioned releases, data contracts/SLAs, and delivery through files, APIs, or data-sharing platforms.
* **2+ years managing offshore teams in India**, including recurring India-hours calls and cross-time-zone handoffs.
* Hands-on **Jira and Confluence administration**, including project setup, workflows, issue types, boards, dashboards, and process adoption.
* Proven ability to restructure Jira and establish consistent team usage.
* Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear status reports, scope documents, decisions, and release notes without requiring verbal explanation.
* Strong ability to turn ambiguous requirements into **clear, actionable engineering work**.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a **data provider, data-licensing company, or organization selling data products** to external customers.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or SAFe certification.
* Familiarity with **entity resolution, record linkage, or master data management**.
* Exposure to government/public-sector data programs.
* Experience in a **founder-led or high-growth environment** where delivery processes had to be built and improved.

**Success in the First 90 Days**

* Daily standup operates **without CEO involvement** and consistently finishes within 30 minutes.
* Jira becomes the **single source of truth**, with every active item having an owner, due date, and current status.
* Commercial delivery commitments and product releases are visible through a single delivery calendar.
* India team calls run with clear agendas, decisions, owners, and action items.
* At least one recurring data-product refresh ships using documented QA and release criteria.
* Leadership receives consistent weekly delivery reporting without needing follow-up clarification.
* **Meeting volume decreases materially**, with routine status, decisions, and follow-ups handled asynchronously through Jira and written documentation.

Pay: $70.00 - $75.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

REMOTE | US

**About Us**

Property Leads delivers high-quality, motivated seller leads to real estate investors, and we're expanding into home services. We're a quiet but mighty start-up that participated in 50% of off-market home sales in the last 12 months. We move fast, we're data-driven, and we care about results.

Our customers are real estate investors and roofers/roofing companies running real businesses on our leads. When something breaks for them, it matters, and fixing it fast is how we grow. If you want to check the box on responding to a ticket without solving the problem, this isn't the place. If you want to own real customer relationships and get on the phone to solve real problems, it is.

Once Sales converts a prospect into a customer, you own the account for its lifetime: you build the relationship, keep them buying, and grow what they spend. Retention, expansion, and goodwill are your job, and your book of business is your number.

**Responsibilities**

* Take the handoff from Sales at go-live, run onboarding, and get each customer to early results fast.
* Monitor account health (purchase frequency, lead quality feedback, support history, payment activity) and reach out before customers go quiet.
* Build goodwill by responding fast, telling customers the truth, following through, and advocating for them internally.
* Grow accounts through new markets and increased budget once the customer's core concerns are resolved.
* When an account is at risk, overcome their objections and redirect them back to their original goal.
* Log every customer conversation, risk, and outcome in the CRM.

**Requirements**

* Strong negotiation, objection handling, and de-escalation skills.
* Comfortable in a CRM and managing a pipeline.
* Nice to have: lead-gen or other repeat-purchase experience; real estate investor, roofer, or very small-business customers; experience as a real estate investor/agent or roofer.

**Results**

* Retention: When a customer requests to cancel, you overcome their objections to keep them spending.

We're seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Supply Chain & Operations Specialist to join our growing team on a part-time basis.

We're seeking an experienced property claims professional to help build and deliver technical learning programs that strengthen claim handling quality, compliance, customer outcomes, and associate development.

In this role, you'll combine deep claims expertise with training, coaching, and quality analysis to identify performance opportunities, develop learning solutions, and influence claims excellence across the organization.

**Deliver Training & Develop Talent**

* Lead technical claims, compliance, quality, and operational training initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted resource supporting associate growth and capability development.
  

  

**Identify Opportunities for Improvement**

**Measure Impact**

* Monitor improvement efforts and continuously refine learning content and delivery methods.
* Provide leadership with insights on trends, risks, and learning outcomes.
  

  

**Partner Across Claims**

* Collaborate with Claims leadership, Quality & Compliance, Operations, and business partners to support organizational goals.
* Support regulatory, system, process, and business transformation initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Lead complex infrastructure and commercial construction projects from planning through delivery. You’ll coordinate teams, schedules, budgets, contracts, and site activities while keeping work aligned with construction plans and applicable regulations. Your construction site experience and project leadership will help teams resolve challenges and deliver coordinated work.

**Duties**

* Direct construction project management, project coordination, and construction schedule coordination across project teams and stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, estimates, and cost controls; track progress and address risks or delays.
* Review construction plans, blueprints, schematics, and contracts to coordinate scope, resources, and field execution.
* Oversee site activities and support construction regulatory compliance, including adherence to applicable construction regulations.
* Your impact: By coordinating teams, schedules, and costs, you help clients and field crews complete infrastructure work safely and in line with project requirements.

**Requirements**

* Experience in construction project management, construction management, and managing teams in a construction management role; commercial construction experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex infrastructure projects, construction budgets, cost management, construction estimating, project scheduling, and construction scheduling.
* Ability to read blueprints, construction plans, and schematics; knowledge of contracts and construction regulatory compliance.
* Familiarity with construction management software and project management software, such as ProCore, Bluebeam, Primavera, Primavera P6, Prolog, Civil 3D, or HeavyBid.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, strong time management, and experience coordinating construction projects.

Pay: $30.00 - $50.00 per week

Work Location: Remote
